parsed.note_claim: Europeans have been using soap for 1000s of years, long before the Moors colonised a small corner of Europe.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: It is another 2000 years before both Greek (Galen, Method of Medicine, VIII. line 569k) and Roman (Pliny, Natural History, XXVIII.191; Martial, Epigrams, VIII.20; XIV.27 & 27) authors mention soap.
parsed.reason: The page confirms that Greek and Roman authors mentioned soap 2000 years ago, substantiating the note's claim that Europeans used soap for thousands of years prior to the Moorish presence.
